wordmark.purpose: Sidebar OPENRIG wordmark, the sun's YOU label, the Backlog ring centre name. Uppercase. Brand moments only.

count-display.purpose: The single big number at the centre of the Backlog ring.

headline.purpose: Pane heading in split views (Attention, Projects, Specs).

map-title.purpose: Rig or mission name at the top-left of the map, beside the layer switch; drawer headings share the size.

title.purpose: List-column and view heads in 58px rows.

body.purpose: Running text; tabular numerals set globally on body.

label.purpose: Uppercase section heads, table heads, list group heads. The heading itself, never a kicker above another heading.

mono.purpose: Ids, commands, session names and terminal text only.

extensions.elevationNote: No box-shadows, glows, gradients or backdrop blur. Depth is tonal (ground, panel, well, hairline) plus the orrery's lit/shadow layer split. Overlays (toast, tooltips) are inverted blocks, not lifted cards.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Travel only: orbit swap, drawer panel entry, phone sheets, toast, receipt, pane entry.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Background, border and colour transitions on buttons, segments, nav, rows and bodies.

motion.name: orbit-swap
motion.value: position and size 480ms ease-out; opacity 320ms ease-out
motion.purpose: Layers exchange lit and shadow places. Eased because it is travel, not rotation. Instant under reduced motion.

motion.name: drawer-in
motion.value: translateX(24px) to none with fade, 240ms ease-out
motion.purpose: The inner drawer panel slides; the drawer width snaps.

motion.name: phone-sheet
motion.purpose: Off-canvas sidebar and detail sheet on phone.

motion.name: clockwork
motion.purpose: The backdrop OGCC mark behind the map and the Backlog ring. Never eases, never reacts to interaction; pauses when the tab is hidden.

motion.name: flow
motion.purpose: Qitem dots travelling handoff edges. Hidden under reduced motion.

motion.name: alarm
motion.value: scale 1 to 1.3 with fade, 2.4s ease-out infinite
motion.purpose: Brick ring on a stalled, unowned body. Static ring under reduced motion.

motion.name: undo-window
motion.purpose: Drain line under the Attention receipt.

theming.overrides: Adopters add or override presets via /theme.json; viewers override any token in the Theme panel. Unset tokens fall back to OGCC.

narrative.overview:
This is oakgreen.cc's night sky put to work. The splash page's orrery (a dark, slow mechanical sky with the OGCC mark as sun) becomes the console's home: the rig and its mission are two systems sharing one sky, pods as square stations on the inner orbit, seats as bodies around them, workflow steps on the far track. One system is lit and the other sits in shadow; picking a shadowed body swaps them. Everything else (Attention, Backlog, Projects, Specs, Terminals, System) is the same ground, panel and hairline carried into lists, panes and tables.

Density is operational, not decorative: a 232px sidebar, a work area, and a right drawer on pick. Hierarchy comes from weight, case and tone, never from colour noise. The brand's clockwork survives: a giant OGCC mark turns linearly in Shadow Orbit behind the map and the Backlog ring, and nothing else in the machine spins.

The lineage is explicit. **Kept from OGCC:** the One Hue Rule (Signal Green is the only brand hue), the toy-ink family for everything that is not the brand (here repurposed as status), square corners, no shadows, no glow, no gradients, system-ui as the only face, linear clockwork rotation of the backdrop mark, and Sektor green never appearing. **Expanded for an operate surface:** hairline rules and bordered panels are allowed (the splash page had none); a light "Daylight" variant derived from the same ramps; status inks are lifted to L≈72–77% so they read as text on the dark ground (the splash inks sat at L≈61% as drawn objects); the orbit-swap tween eases, because it is travel, not rotation.
keyCharacteristics: One brand hue (Signal Green) per preset; status in toy inks; every colour a token.
Square everything (0 radius); 1px hairlines in shadow tone; flat tonal layering.
system-ui for all text and all counts; ui-monospace only for ids, commands and terminal text.
The orrery is the signature: lit/shadow dual layers, seats as motes in shadow, a clockwork backdrop mark.
Fully themeable: presets carry dark and light variants; adopters override any token via `/theme.json` or the Theme panel, falling back to OGCC.

rules.name: The One Hue Rule
rules.body: Within a preset, the accent is the only brand hue. Selection, focus, "you" and flow are Signal Green; nothing else borrows it. A new element that needs a second brand colour is the wrong element.

rules.name: The Ink Means Status Rule
rules.body: Brick, brass, cobalt, lavender and pewter carry state and nothing else, always with a text or shape cue beside them so state is never colour alone.

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: Every colour painted comes from a token in the preset; no raw colours in stylesheets. Tints of a token use `color-mix(in oklch, ...)` against another token.

rules.name: The Guest Mark Rule
rules.body: Sektor's #41ff19 never appears in the console and never stands for OGCC.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Numerals in counts, ratios and ages are system-ui with tabular figures (set on `body`). Monospace is only for ids, commands and terminal text; a count in mono is wrong.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: No kicker or eyebrow sits above a heading. The kind of a thing (spec kind, item kind, state) goes in a chip or a leading word on the meta line under the heading, or in front of the scope line in a list row.

rules.name: The Two-Line Reason Rule
rules.body: A station's subtitle is the sentence the map exists to say: it wraps to two lines at word boundaries, and only the second line may truncate.

rules.name: The Snap-Then-Slide Rule
rules.body: The drawer's width snaps open (the map re-lays out once, not per frame); only the inner panel slides in on a transform (24px, 240ms, ease-out). On phone the whole sheet slides on transform.

rules.name: The Title-Beside-Switch Rule
rules.body: The map's layer switch lives at the top-left beside the map title, never floating elsewhere on the sky.

rules.name: The No-Glow Rule
rules.body: Any shadow, glow or blur breaks the night sky. Emphasis is a stroke width, a tint ground, or an inversion.

rules.name: The Tinted Shadow Rule
rules.body: The shadow layer is tinted from tokens (ground fill, Shadow Orbit dashed stroke, muted label), never a greyscale or opacity filter over the lit style. The one-hue world stays green in shadow, and shadow labels hold at least 3:1 on the ground.

dos: **Do** take every colour from a preset token, and let anything a theme leaves unset fall back to OGCC.
**Do** keep Signal Green for selection, focus, "you" and flow only; speak status in the toy inks with a text cue beside them.
**Do** keep all corners square and all rules 1px hairlines in the shadow tone.
**Do** put an item's kind in a chip or a leading word on the meta line, not above the heading.
**Do** tint the shadow layer from tokens and keep its labels at 3:1 or better.
**Do** set counts in system-ui tabular figures; reserve mono for ids, commands and terminal text.
**Do** wrap station reasons to two lines and wrap commands only between tokens.
**Do** rotate the backdrop mark linearly; ease only travel (the orbit swap, drawer and sheet entry, toasts).
**Do** drop travel and loops under `prefers-reduced-motion` while keeping state visible.
donts: **Don't** use box-shadows, glows, gradients or backdrop blur.
**Don't** place kickers or eyebrows above headings.
**Don't** greyscale or filter the shadow layer; it stays green.
**Don't** set counts or ratios in monospace.
**Don't** ease, speed up or stop the clockwork backdrop for interaction.
**Don't** animate the drawer's width; snap it and slide the inner panel.
**Don't** use Sektor green (#41ff19) anywhere in the console.
**Don't** introduce a second brand hue within a preset.
